csv_agency: Austin Peay State Univ Purchasing Dept
csv_scope_of_work: Austin Peay State University, hereinafter referred to as APSU or Landlord, is seeking proposals from qualified developers or development teams to plan, design, finance, construct, and operate a residential multi-family housing development. This residential multi-family housing development will be referred to as the Development and would be built on property leased from APSU at 210 College Street, Clarksville, TN ( Leased Premises ).
csv_comments: '* * * ADVANCE NOTICE * * *Project Info: The RFP/Q has been cancelled and will be re-advertised in the Next Week.- IMS requests NO PHONE CALLS, NO FAXES, and NO CONTACT with agency at this time.- Project No: APSU27-001- The RFQ/RFP package is expected to be available prior to 08/01/2026
title: Developer for Residential Multi-Family Housing
short_description: Developer sought for planning, financing, constructing, and operating university residential housing.
project_scope: Austin Peay State University seeks a qualified developer or development team for a residential multi-family housing development on university-owned land to be leased to the developer. The scope includes planning, design, financing, construction, and operation of the development. No gross floor area, unit count, structural system, or other technical characteristics are stated in the notice.
services: Design-build/developer services including planning, design, financing, construction, and operation of a residential multi-family housing development.
relevance_explanation:
- Residential multi-family housing is a general building type and not a core sbp target sector.
- No indication of special structural complexity, long spans, lightweight structures, or innovative engineering.
- Procurement is primarily for a developer/design-build team rather than focused structural engineering services.
- Could involve building design, but the notice provides no evidence of a large or architecturally demanding structure.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. Useful missing inputs for an estimate include number of housing units, gross floor area, building height, parking scope, quality standard, and site constraints. With only the current information, no realistic estimate is possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The notice is for a developer/design-build procurement and does not define a structural engineering scope, fee basis, or construction budget, so no realistic sbp fee estimate is possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified developers or development teams are requested; no specific reference counts, project types, or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice.
contracting_authority: Austin Peay State University Purchasing Department, Clarksville, TN, USA. Contact: Patricia Walton. Email: waltonp@apsu.edu. Phone: 931-221-7573. Website: https://www.apsu.edu/procurement/vendors/bids/
notes: Advance notice only. The RFP/Q was cancelled and will be re-advertised the following week. Project No. APSU27-001. RFQ/RFP package expected before 08/01/2026. IMS requests no phone calls, no faxes, and no contact with the agency at this time.
